cause: SystemStateProvider treated absence/failure of backend truth as READY and read data.state instead of top-level SystemEnvelope.state.
failed_approach: Optimistic READY initialization plus silent error handling for a blocking state source.
recovery: Use nullable canonical state, explicit readiness, exact top-level parser, visible UNKNOWN and fail-closed action gates.
boundary: No blocking UI action may rely on an inferred/default system state.
prevention: ui-system-state-truth contract tests + full web typecheck/CI.
